integrity: The exact Gray generator was independently reconstructed from the defining set and Gray-coordinate formulas in the source. The published ordinary weight enumerator is reproduced exactly. All \(2824\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are enumerated once in RREF, and every support is checked both directly and through the two-subspace intersection formula.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only Example 4.4 with \(q=2\), \(m=3\), \(A=\{1,2\}\), and \(B=\{1,3\}\). No general formula for every Gray image in Theorem 4.3 is claimed. One closely related 2026 antiGriesmer source was available only at abstract level, so exact same-object coverage there remains a residual literature risk despite negative exact-parameter searches.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the new optimal \([96,6,48]\) Gray-image code
